changes: Macros have WoW Forever presets for every class's new spells and talents, use Forever's renamed spells and drop the ones it removed. Classic Era and TBC keep their own.

Create adds stance or form, an alternative action on a modifier, right-click or out of combat (yourself, focus, cursor, another spell or a lower rank), pet orders, a channel guard, gear swaps and an announce line.
Open WoW macros now shows on Create, and preset cards are one line shorter. Open macros with /hg macros in Highground or /hgm in Highground Macros.
notice: Use /reload after updating; this release adds no addon files. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
